SteamCounter - third-party software and font notices
Exact Windows runtime and build dependencies from Cargo.lock. Libraries, fonts and other assets retain their original licenses. Texts are included below and identical texts are shared by reference number. These notices are embedded in the standalone executable and available in Settings > View licenses.
SteamCounter source is GPL-3.0-or-later. The MPL-2.0 components are also made available under GPL-3.0-or-later as part of this combined work, under MPL section 3.3; their original MPL notices remain intact. The matching source and source-download index are in the same version tag at https://github.com/Matteo842/SteamCounter. See docs/third-party/SOURCES.md.
The app is not affiliated with Valve, SteamCharts or SteamDB. These licenses do not license their data or trademarks.

The goals of the Open Font License (OFL) are to stimulate worldwide
